sections.heading: MAJOR IN ENGLISH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 from English 1000 to 1999 with a mark of at least 60%. Students will be eligible for an Honours BA with a double major if they obtain a 70% average in the courses of each major module with no mark less than 60% in each course. No failures on options.
